teaser: A design proposal for PrompTugal.news as a ground-up newsroom: every story filed at an address, climbing with its proof. Mockups from live data.
core_idea: News should start local: file every story at an address and let it climb to the region and the country through sourced connections, with the proof designed in.

nodes.label: Every story has an address
nodes.summary: A story is filed where it happened: a parish, a town, a region.

nodes.label: A story climbs
nodes.summary: It reaches the region and the country only through sourced connections.

nodes.label: The by-place data
nodes.summary: 19 editions with 116 stories, 182 organisations and 166 gaps.

nodes.label: ALGAR's AI tool
nodes.summary: Filed in Almancil, climbing to Loulé, the pilots, the Algarve and Portugal.

nodes.label: A front page with no national desk
nodes.summary: The national page is assembled from the local files.

nodes.label: Gaps are journalism
nodes.summary: Each place says what it could not find.

nodes.label: Ground-up news
nodes.summary: The recommended name for the method, under the PrompTugal.news masthead.

nodes.label: The locality layer
nodes.summary: Parishes, municipalities and neighbours, so thin towns lean on others.

quotes.text: The national front page has no national desk.
Gaps are journalism: they tell the reader what we looked for and where we could not see
quotes.why: Why empty pages are not empty.
